label: Preservation
resolution: Q.104 a.1 distinguishes direct dependence for esse from preventing corruption. Only the former is the proposed subject of a cause-of-esse interpretation; guardian-like protection is not identified with CausesIn at esse. Neither sense is arbitrary modal power. Atemporal record-source cuts are a separate analyst dependency component, not a third lexical preservation sense or declarations for PRESERVATION_1/2. The positive receipt, same-bearer esse interpretation and record-coverage bridges remain explicit; successful process prevention and productive giving are not identified. See docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md, Atemporal source-cut component (2026-11-17).
